subject.title: Telegram group chat history entries lose media data (only placeholder text preserved)

question: Should Telegram retain unmentioned group image media for later mentioned turns, and if so behind what opt-in retention limits?
rationale: Current main intentionally avoids downloading unaddressed mention-gated media, while the requested behavior would retain and later expose media from messages that did not mention the bot.

options.title: Add opt-in bounded retention
options.body: Keep the safe default, add a Telegram-owned opt-in retention policy with strict caps/TTL/redaction, and prove it with source tests plus live Telegram evidence.

options.title: Keep privacy default only
options.body: Leave unmentioned media unretained and close or mark the request not planned because later mentions can only inspect media that was addressed or explicitly supplied.

options.title: Retain by default
options.body: Fix the UX for all mention-gated groups but accept a broader privacy and disk-retention change for existing deployments.

recommendation.title: Add opt-in bounded retention
recommendation.body: Keep the safe default, add a Telegram-owned opt-in retention policy with strict caps/TTL/redaction, and prove it with source tests plus live Telegram evidence.

likelyOwner.reason: This choice crosses the core history-media behavior he recently authored and the product/security boundary in VISION.md.
